ios.desc:
Three Cells helps you build habits you can stick to with a fast daily check-in for habits, mood, and visible progress.

Stay consistent every day. Log the habits that matter, reflect on your day, and see proof that your effort is turning into a streak, a pattern, and a better routine.

What you can track:
- Habit streaks, heatmaps, and completion history
- Mood and short daily reflections
- Health and progress metrics like weight, sleep, workouts, focus, and reading
- Notebooks for notes, ideas and photos
- Shareable progress cards for visible proof

Built for people who want a self-improvement system they can use on bad days too: simple, fast, and focused on consistency.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Full access to all features in Three Cells is available through a paid plan. You can choose a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Before subscribing or purchasing, you have limited access to preview features.

If you choose a Three Cells subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time in your Apple Account settings.

If you choose the Three Cells lifetime purchase, a one-time payment unlocks full access permanently, with no recurring charges.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Anyone should be able to view it, even without an Apple account: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/three-cells-your-life-system/id6747948986#:~:text=Free-,In%2DApp%20Purchases,-Three%20Cells%20Weekly (bottom right):

> Three Cells Weekly $2.99

> Lifetime Access to Three Cells $29.99

> Three Cells Weekly $2.99

The ratio here feels a bit off, $155.48/y or $29.99 for life screams "trying to push you to pay a lot for an app I know you won't stick with" rather than "we've got great value options for any type of user". There is a 7 day trial as well, so even more confusing as to which kind of user is supposed to want the weekly payment.
